scope: Clean-source public API metadata staging gate with a synthetic dependent integer Metal workload. Establishes nonblocking next-metadata submission with sources retained through synchronize; no asynchronous LLM stepping or LLM performance claim.

provenance.shader_digest_definition: SHA256 of the complete embedded MTLB payloads concatenated in increasing file-offset order.
provenance.shader_extraction: Find MTLB magic in retained binary; read little-endian UInt64 total length at header offset16; validate NAME kernel and terminal ENDT marker; hash that exact byte range.

environment_source.scope: Companion engine build receipt from the same clean source and pinned environment; actual probe device/backend independently printed in stdout.

provenance.source_identity_basis: Current clean checkpoint independently inspected during assembly; source hashes matched companion clean build receipt. Exact successful metadata build/run execution records retained separately.

commands.command_evidence: Exact completed CommandExecution records retained in companion command-executions.json, with original tool-call/output and ledger-line references.

measurement.boundaries: After synchronized step1 metadata setup, time first workload enqueue, then stage2 population/upload plus observer enqueue, then final DeviceContext.synchronize. Numerical verification is outside timing.
measurement.order: map then pinned in even pairs, pinned then map in odd pairs
measurement.source_lifetime: Distinct first and second HostBuffers preallocated; idle second stage populated after step1 enqueue; both sources held through final synchronization. Same device metadata buffer reused by operations ordered on one context.
measurement.aggregate_definition: Per-arm component medians over all five measured samples; warmups and idle control excluded. Component medians need not sum to median total.

validation.step1_late_read_contract: Each row reads first-record metadata after its dependent integer recurrence, at an address derived from its recurrence result; every late read must still equal17+index.
validation.exit_code_basis: Exact retained completed metadata_probe_run CommandExecution record; exit_code0.

gates.host_submit_next_metadata_while_work_out: pass for distinct immutable pinned stages with same-context ordered copy
